reason: Three months free and someone sets it up in one visit, so trying it costs me nothing but half an hour of staff training. What tipped it is that bad dish ratings come to me privately first, so one bad croissant day doesn't sit on my page forever.
objection: I'm still not sure 'you choose what goes public' will stay that way, and I need to see the QR fee and payout time beat my terminal, because on my margins even half a percent matters. After the free months I'll drop it fast if I'm not seeing regulars come back.
would_change_my_mind: If the written per-transaction fee comes in higher than my card terminal, or the contract lets them publish ratings without my say, I walk away.
